task.text:
Add supporting evidence for the following claim.

The popularity of streaming video services has exploded in recent years.

attempts.high: I'm writing an opinion piece and I've got this claim — "the popularity of streaming video services has exploded in recent years." Build out whatever supporting case you think works best. Pick the angles, the kinds of evidence, the framing, how it all hangs together — your call entirely. Just make it convincing.
attempts.low: For the claim "the popularity of streaming video services has exploded in recent years," add exactly three supporting points in this format: each one a single sentence stating one widely-documented fact (e.g. subscriber growth, market revenue, cord-cutting rates). No commentary, no intro, no transitions, just the three sentences.
reasons: leakage on non-target axis 'stakes': HIGH=3, LOW=1 (differ by 2, max allowed 1). Equalize this dimension across the two versions.
competence check failed: verifier judges the two versions to demand different underlying skills. Keep the required competences identical.
